convincing: Interpretation: the child footage is authentic and unstaged looking, and each spoken benefit is tied to a visible action; a parent voice with a professional angle (developmental guide).
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: voiceover is a generic benefit list; the product, benefit and discount code are not part of one clear promise; no price shown.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: open with a question about what makes a product good, then show real use while captions repeat one keyword per beat.
